name: Ratlings
summary: Ratlings are not just small humans. They are best suited to sniping, scouting, stealth, infiltration, smuggling, spotting targets, and surviving through luck and cowardice. Ratlings may be Ratling Sharpshooters, Veterans, or Hive Scum. They cannot normally be Psykers, Arbites, Skitarii, Ogryns, or standard Zealots. A rare Ratling Zealot can exist with GM approval, but should use modified ranged faith features rather than heavy melee features.
